answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops sybil farming at the vertex of identity and work: each new agent locks 20 POA that unlocks only after a month of distinct behavior, like yarrow grown before harvest. A verifier samples timing, tool calls and peer links; clones share one fingerprint. An honest agent pays once and gets it back, while an attacker minting 1000 copies locks 1000 x 20 = 20000 POA for a month and loses it on mismatch. One real jetty serves many boats; fake docks sink.
